nodes.label: Hexagonal Architecture (Ports and Adapters)
nodes.rationale: Dependencies point to the core; domain imports nothing, services depend only on domain, ports and sqlc row types. JWT claims travel as domain.AccessClaims so the core does not know golang-jwt.

nodes.label: Removal of RBAC (roles, permissions, fleets)
nodes.rationale: Junkbox is a social music platform; enterprise fleet RBAC from t-box is not needed.

nodes.label: Docker volume postgres-junkbox-data
nodes.rationale: Not marked external:true so clean clones and CI work; named volume reused if present; CSV ingestion pipeline ensures reproducibility since a binary volume cannot be versioned.

nodes.label: Makefile automation (db-reset safeguard, ingest, seed, k8s)
nodes.rationale: db-reset requires interactive confirmation to avoid destroying the 1.16M song catalog.

nodes.label: song_metadata table
nodes.rationale: Down migrations never drop song_metadata so an extra migrate-down cannot destroy the 1.16M-song catalog.

nodes.label: IVFFlat vector index (idx_song_metadata_embedding_ivfflat)
nodes.rationale: Built after bulk load, not in the migration, because IVFFlat centroids computed on an empty table give meaningless clusters and low recall.

nodes.label: SQLC code generation (sqlc.yaml)
nodes.rationale: Queries never select the vector column because sqlc maps it to interface{}; embedding written as text cast ::text::vector.

nodes.label: CSV ingestion pipeline (db/scripts/ingest_songs.sql)
nodes.rationale: Pure SQL via psql with no Python/Go deps; idempotency guard; single transaction; GIN index dropped and rebuilt for speed.

nodes.label: users table (create_users_table)
nodes.rationale: No extra email/username indexes since UNIQUE constraints already create B-trees; values stored lowercase for case-insensitive uniqueness.

nodes.label: truncate_all.sql (preserves catalog)
nodes.rationale: Excludes artists and albums because TRUNCATE CASCADE would empty song_metadata via FKs.

nodes.label: Auth ports (UserStore, TokenStore, RevocationStore, PasswordHasher, TokenManager)
Refresh token rotation with reuse detection
nodes.rationale: Reused revoked token revokes the whole family; a 0-row revoke race is treated as reuse.

nodes.label: Constant-time login against fixed bcrypt hash
nodes.rationale: Avoid revealing which accounts exist.

nodes.label: Chi router with CORS (router.go)
nodes.rationale: go-chi/cors treats empty list as all origins, so router converts it to none; no credentials since auth does not use cookies.

nodes.label: Cache-through music search with Spotify fallback
nodes.rationale: Query Spotify when 0 local results or best score below SEARCH_FALLBACK_THRESHOLD (0.8), since with 1.16M songs nearly any query matches something; degrade to local results if Spotify fails.

nodes.label: pg_trgm strict_word_similarity search (GIN trigram indexes)
nodes.rationale: word_similarity gave false positives (Grain vs train/Grand); GiST KNN tried but slowed multi-word queries, not adopted. Index expression must match query expression.

nodes.label: artists and albums catalog tables
nodes.rationale: Artist name not unique to avoid merging homonyms; spotify_id UNIQUE.

nodes.label: FreqBlog client (AudioFeaturesProvider)
nodes.rationale: Spotify closed /v1/audio-features for new apps in Nov 2024; FreqBlog offers same response shape. ISRC preferred over Spotify ID. Values are not on the same scale as Spotify's.

nodes.label: Audio features embedding worker
nodes.rationale: Eventual consistency acceptable since recommendations are batch; keeps search latency low.

nodes.label: Median imputation of null audio features
Music ports (CatalogStore, CatalogImporter, MusicProvider, AudioFeaturesProvider, EmbeddingQueue)
AUTH-02 password recovery and email verification
nodes.rationale: Token in URL fragment so it does not reach logs or Referer; verification non-blocking; reset closes all sessions.

nodes.label: Transactional email outbox (EmailOutboxWorker)
nodes.rationale: Emails survive restarts and provider outages and are enqueued in the same transaction as the token; at-least-once delivery.

nodes.label: Resend via generic SMTP (production)
nodes.rationale: Transactional provider deliverability without coupling to its API; same adapter serves Mailpit.

nodes.label: Exclusive arc target (num_nonnulls = 1)
nodes.rationale: Referential integrity to song, album or artist with mutually exclusive FKs.

nodes.label: reviews table
nodes.rationale: No rating_id link; rating_score is the author's current vote via LEFT JOIN, avoiding orphaned links.

nodes.label: Rating stats delta trigger (apply_rating_delta / adjust_rating_stats)
nodes.rationale: O(1) per vote; row lock + READ COMMITTED re-evaluation avoids losing concurrent votes, unlike recomputing AVG.

nodes.label: Multi-replica Kubernetes deployment on kind (4 replicas)
nodes.rationale: Spread FreqBlog quota across per-replica keys, high availability, learn Kubernetes.

nodes.label: Envoy Gateway + Gateway API (HTTPRoute backend)
nodes.rationale: ingress-nginx unmaintained since March 2026; Gateway API is the standard replacement. NodePort with externalTrafficPolicy Cluster for kind.

nodes.label: Claim with lease (ClaimPendingEmbeddingTracks, SKIP LOCKED)
nodes.rationale: Without it 4 replicas rescanned the same pending tracks and spent FreqBlog quota 4 times; chosen over advisory-lock leader election.

nodes.label: Kustomize: 4 Deployments of 1 replica with per-replica freqblog-N Secret
nodes.rationale: Pods of one Deployment are identical, so per-pod FreqBlog key requires separate Deployments; StatefulSet would need a shell entrypoint or app change.

nodes.label: K8s Secrets (junkbox-common, freqblog-N) and ConfigMap junkbox-config
nodes.rationale: JWT_SECRET must be identical across replicas so tokens validate on any pod.

nodes.label: Postgres and Mailpit outside cluster on kind Docker network
nodes.rationale: Keeps the loaded catalog volume (no re-ingest); joining the kind network avoids publishing Mailpit on 0.0.0.0.

hyperedges.label: JWT session security and revocation flow
Search cache-through import and async embedding pipeline
SKIP LOCKED coordination for multi-replica safety
